mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals labor market deterioration, which typically precedes economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales signals broad consumer demand weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS does not produce negative 20-day returns in at least 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of rising industrial production, inflationary pressures build, leading to central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO rises by more than 0.5% month-over-month, the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase above 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting Fed tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 3.5%, the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in employment (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when PAYEMS increases by at least 100,000 jobs.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and quarterly GDP growth signals a deepening economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and GDPC1 does not produce negative 20-day returns in at least 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: During high interest rate regimes (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), elevated discount rates suppress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%, the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.
